description: Returns what changed in the MCP and A2A specifications since a date, each as a short summary in our own words with a link to the release notes. A short curated list, not a full changelog. Example output: {"since":"2026-01-01","count":4,"changes":[{"spec":"MCP specification","tag":"2026-07-28"}]}. Optional argument: date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2026-01-01". With no arguments it starts on 1 January of the snapshot year. Good for 'What changed in the MCP spec this year?'.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2026-01-01". Optional: empty means 1 January of the snapshot year.
date.title: Date

name: spec_changes_since
